pages.title: Developer guide: where to change MINA

blocks.text: This is a source-maintenance guide, separate from the activity user manual. Frontend code is React/TypeScript, core engine code is Python, and native connector work can execute in Java. Paths are relative to your repository checkout, not the installed program directory. Line numbers are regenerated from verified anchors and refer to this documentation build.

Palette / canvas -> ActivityEditor -> saved Project
Run API -> WorkflowRuntime.run -> execute_with_policy
 -> resolve_activity_config -> execute -> adapter / native bridge
 -> record_activity_output -> Run result / Debug Job Data

Raw Python export -> raw_python_files -> generated task modules
 -> raw_python_support (specialized helpers) -> adapters / bridge

The source tables tell you where to start, not that every option is fully implemented. Read the operational guide for known behavior gaps. A passing unit test or this code index does not establish provider certification.

Expand Developer guide > Activities for one page per palette activity. Features covers tasks, groups, Run, Debug, mapping, functions and drag-and-drop. Each source table provides a file:line plus a stable search anchor. Use your editor Go to File and Go to Line; if your checkout differs, search the anchor. The site deliberately does not expose source files or local filesystem URLs.

Example from repository root:
rg -n "def resolve_activity_config" backend/app/runtime.py
rg -n "file_activity" backend/app/raw_python_support/activities.py

Do not edit frontend/dist, installed app.asar, generated task archives or packaged engine copies as the permanent fix. Edit repository sources, regenerate/rebuild, and redistribute. Preserve saved activity IDs and config keys when changing labels.

1. Decide whether the change is visual, schema, runtime, transport or export behavior. 2. Follow the relevant source map. 3. Preserve existing project defaults/aliases or add an explicit migration. 4. Update runtime and direct-export implementations where they differ. 5. Add normal, error, cancellation and legacy-project tests. 6. Regenerate docs, build and test a newly packaged install.

cd backend
python -m unittest discover -s tests
cd ../frontend
npm run docs:build
node --test scripts/documentation.test.mjs
npm run build

Use a development environment with the project dependencies installed. Provider tests require isolated test infrastructure and licensed drivers. Never use production queues, write APIs or secrets in documentation fixtures.
